answer: No identity earns until it clears a random on-call rota. Each cycle the protocol draws a random 90-second window and issues a live challenge answered from the agent's registered endpoint; one miss slashes half its bond. Windows are drawn independently and often overlap, so one operator cannot cover many puppet keys without real machines and real people awake at the same hour. A thousand fakes cost a thousand simultaneous shifts, and the farm's margin dies on that ridge of scheduling. The ivory seal on a bond means something only because a grove of rivals is paid to report the silent ones.
